name: Oskar — strong pilot everywhere else, but only 15 hours on his current wing, shopping a two-liner
summary: Same strength profile as persona 02 on every other question, but current_wing_time is under_20 and is_2_liner is yes.
why_this_persona: This is the single best-evidenced gate in the whole rubric — Lindenstruth's survey and the documented 11-hour reserve-deployment case. Confirms 'two_liner_thin_previous_category' caps the result at Not yet even though every other answer is maxed, and that it is the ONLY gate that fires (the other five two-liner-conditional gates must stay silent since their own underlying skills are all strong).

notes: Computed against the real engine: total 98.8, skills 93.9, psych 100.0, gates: ['two_liner_thin_previous_category'] only.

Gate evaluation short-circuits the threshold rules entirely — rules_expected is empty even though the score alone would clear Ready, which is the whole point of a hard gate: it overrides total score regardless.

The identical answers run through persona 04 (is_2_liner:no_three_liner) produce a DIFFERENT outcome from the same current_wing_time:under_20 answer — nearly_ready via critical_check_floor, not a cap. That pairing is the core proof the two-tracked architecture works as designed.
